A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''Force-user''' was confronted by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He wore a robe resembling that of the [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi apparel]] and wielded a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in battle.

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Forsake Fear" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artist [[Monte Moore]]. Since the time period of the game is set around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]-[[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it is uncertain whether this character may be identified as a proper member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
